fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local columns on Greater Miami civic affairs, including criticism of the Coral Gables city commission following the resignation of public safety director "Pop" Lehman; commentary satirizing hurricane publicity and a Lions Club resolution; debates over school cafeteria policies and children's beverages; calls for stricter milk regulation (certified vs. pasteurized) and improved city food laws; concerns about police uniform costs, fire department staffing and civil service practices, traffic hazards and stop signs, and justice-of-the-peace office practices. Includes "Round the Town" items, a society column, and a market-style list of illicit liquor prices during Prohibition, plus a note on avocado theft in Coral Gables.
